name: Storytelling (Domain) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Storytelling (Domain) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Storytelling (Legendary Domain)" but are not part of the Storytelling (Domain) entry, which is unchanged.

The domain of storytelling is one of history, performance, remembrance, and imagination. As a cleric of the storytelling domain, you remember a multitude of stories that can relate to most situations and believe you have a duty to remember and create new stories. You typically take the role of a traveler, performer, or archivist. Stories can be used to remember the truth or to fit a narrative that benefits you.

Divine Skill: Bluff

Storyteller (Su)

Perform is a class skill for you. In addition, you add your Wisdom instead of Intelligence or Charisma to all Knowledge, Lore, and Performance (Oratory) checks. Before rolling such a check, you can spend 1 point of faith to add a sacred bonus to the check equal to 1/2 your cleric level. This bonus can’t be used for earning money.

Inspiring Stories (Su)
